/-- Pull a supplied certified family on one carve chart to a test algebra and pass to
the locally certified quotient.  This is the choice-free per-chart operation from which
F5's affine forward map is glued. -/
noncomputable def divRepPullAt
    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) : DivFamZar C S pi g :=
  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom omega (DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
@[simp]
theorem divRepPullAt_id
    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J) :
    divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (AlgHom.id k (ChartRing i j))
      = (DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar :=
  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id _

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
/-- Pulling a chart family through two algebra maps is the same as pulling it through
their composite.  This is the algebraic part of F5 naturality. -/
theorem divRepPullAt_comp
    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (phi : S →ₐ[k] T) :
    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega)
      = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (phi.comp omega) :=
  (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp omega phi (DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar).symm
input.new_string:
/-- Pull a supplied Zariski-locally certified **class** on one carve chart to a test
algebra.  This is the choice-free per-chart operation from which F5's affine forward map
is glued.

The supplied datum is a `DivFamZar` class, not a globally certified family: the forward
map only ever transports a class along `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom`, so a global degree-`g`
certificate over the chart ring is never consumed.  A caller that does hold a
`CertifiedDivisorFamily G` on a chart passes `(DivFam.mk G).toZar`, so no expressive
power is lost, while the Zariski-local production rules (`IsLocallyCertified`) become
usable here. -/
noncomputable def divRepPullAt
    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) : DivFamZar C S pi g :=
  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom omega (U i j)

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
@[simp]
theorem divRepPullAt_id
    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J) :
    divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (AlgHom.id k (ChartRing i j))
      = U i j :=
  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id _

set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
/-- Pulling a chart class through two algebra maps is the same as pulling it through
their composite.  This is the algebraic part of F5 naturality. -/
theorem divRepPullAt_comp
    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
      DivFamZar C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
    {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]
    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (phi : S →ₐ[k] T) :
    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega)
      = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (phi.comp omega) :=
  (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp omega phi (U i j)).symm

10	/-!
11	# Conditional assembly kit for affine divisor representability
12	
13	This file isolates the formal tail between a chart-wise universal certified family and
14	the affine equivalence of DDR-9.F6.  It deliberately makes the remaining F5 hypotheses
15	explicit:
16	
17	* `divRepPullAt` pulls a supplied chart family along a map out of a carve-chart ring;
18	* `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible` is the exact choice-independence statement needed to
19	  glue those local pullbacks;
20	* `DivRepAffinePullback` packages the output of that glue together with the two laws and
21	  naturality;
22	* `DivRepAffinePullback.equiv` turns those data into the affine equivalence, using the
23	  already-landed uniqueness theorem for `divRepClassifyZar` for the hom-side law.
24	
25	No universal family, compatibility, inverse law, or representability theorem is asserted
26	here.  The future F5 construction must supply the fields of these interfaces.
27	-/
28	
29	set_option autoImplicit false
30	set_option quotPrecheck false
31	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
32	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
33	
34	universe u
35	
36	open CategoryTheory
37	
38	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
39	
40	open Grassmannian Scheme
41	
42	section Curve
43	
44	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
45	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
46	
47	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepAffKit :
48	    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
49	
50	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
51	  [IsIntegral C.left]
52	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
53	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
54	  [IsDominant pi]
55	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
56	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
57	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
58	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
59	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
60	variable (g : ℕ)
61	variable (hO : Sheaf.h0 (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1)
62	variable (hchi : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
63	variable (r1 r2 : ℕ)
64	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
65	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
66	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
67	  ↥(divisorSections k
68	    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
69	
70	local notation "DivOver" =>
71	  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
72	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
73	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
74	
75	local notation "ChartRing" => fun i j =>
76	  DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
77	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
78	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j
79	
80	local notation "ChartMap" => fun i j =>
81	  divCarveChartToDivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
82	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
83	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm) i j
84	
85	/-! ## F5: pullback from one supplied universal chart family -/
86	
87	/-- Pull a supplied certified family on one carve chart to a test algebra and pass to
88	the locally certified quotient.  This is the choice-free per-chart operation from which
89	F5's affine forward map is glued. -/
90	noncomputable def divRepPullAt
91	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
92	      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
93	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
94	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
95	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) : DivFamZar C S pi g :=
96	  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom omega (DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar
97	
98	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
99	@[simp]
100	theorem divRepPullAt_id
101	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
102	      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
103	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J) :
104	    divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (AlgHom.id k (ChartRing i j))
105	      = (DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar :=
106	  DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id _
107	
108	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
109	/-- Pulling a chart family through two algebra maps is the same as pulling it through
110	their composite.  This is the algebraic part of F5 naturality. -/
111	theorem divRepPullAt_comp
112	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
113	      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
114	    {S T : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] [CommRing T] [Algebra k T]
115	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
116	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (phi : S →ₐ[k] T) :
117	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega)
118	      = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j (phi.comp omega) :=
119	  (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp omega phi (DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar).symm
120	
121	namespace DivRepChartFamily
122	
123	/-- The precise F5 overlap obligation for a supplied family on every carve chart:
124	two chart points inducing the same morphism to `DivScheme` have equal pulled locally
125	certified divisor classes.  The future universal-family construction proves this from
126	its epsilon identity and the total mono theorem. -/
127	def IsCompatible
128	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
129	      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g) : Prop :=
130	  ∀ {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
131	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
132	    (i' : (glueData k g r1).J) (j' : (glueData k g r2).J)
133	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (omega' : ChartRing i' j' →ₐ[k] S),
134	    Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i j
135	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega'.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i' j' →
136	      divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega
137	        = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega'
138	
139	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
140	/-- Compatibility may be applied when both chart presentations are identified with a
141	common morphism.  This is the form used on overlaps of an atlas factorization. -/
142	theorem pullAt_eq_of_eq_common
143	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
144	      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
145	    (hU : IsCompatible (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)
146	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
147	    (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J)
148	    (i' : (glueData k g r1).J) (j' : (glueData k g r2).J)
149	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] S) (omega' : ChartRing i' j' →ₐ[k] S)
150	    (q : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶
151	      DivScheme k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
152	        (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
153	        (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm))
154	    (homega : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i j = q)
155	    (homega' : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega'.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i' j' = q) :
156	    divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega
157	      = divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega' :=
158	  hU i j i' j' omega omega' (homega.trans homega'.symm)
159	
160	end DivRepChartFamily
161	
162	/-! ## F6: package a completed affine pullback as an equivalence -/
163	
164	/-- The exact output expected from F5 before the affine equivalence is packaged.
165	`isDivRepClassify_pull` is the hom-side law in the refinement-stable clause spelling;
166	classifier uniqueness turns it into the second inverse law automatically. -/
167	structure DivRepAffinePullback where
168	  pull : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S],
169	    (overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) → DivFamZar C S pi g
170	  pull_classify : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
171	    (F : DivFamZar C S pi g),
172	    pull S (divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F) = F
173	  isDivRepClassify_pull : ∀ (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S]
174	    (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver),
175	    IsDivRepClassify hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 (pull S v) v.left
176	  pull_naturality : ∀ {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
177	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (phi : A →ₐ[k] B) (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver),
178	    pull B (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ v) = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi (pull A v)
179	
180	namespace DivRepAffinePullback
181	
182	/-- The affine representability equivalence assembled from an F5 pullback package.
183	The inverse is the landed backward classifier; its hom-side inverse law follows from
184	`divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify`. -/
185	noncomputable def equiv
186	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
187	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] :
188	    (overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) ≃ DivFamZar C S pi g where
189	  toFun := D.pull S
190	  invFun := divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S
191	  left_inv v :=
192	    (divRepClassifyZar_eq_of_isDivRepClassify hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2
193	      (D.pull S v) v (D.isDivRepClassify_pull S v)).symm
194	  right_inv := D.pull_classify S
195	
196	@[simp]
197	theorem equiv_apply
198	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
199	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver) :
200	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
201	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D S v = D.pull S v :=
202	  rfl
203	
204	@[simp]
205	theorem equiv_symm_apply
206	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
207	    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (F : DivFamZar C S pi g) :
208	    (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
209	      (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D S).symm F
210	      = divRepClassifyZar hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2 S F :=
211	  rfl
212	
213	/-- Naturality of the assembled affine equivalence, in the frozen DDR-9 spelling. -/
214	theorem equiv_naturality
215	    (D : DivRepAffinePullback hpi g hO hchi r1 r2 b1 b2)
216	    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
217	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] (phi : A →ₐ[k] B)
218	    (v : overSpec k A ⟶ DivOver) :
219	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
220	        (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D B (Over.overSpecMap phi ≫ v)
221	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom phi
222	          (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (hO := hO) (hchi := hchi) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2)
223	            (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D A v) :=
224	  D.pull_naturality phi v
225	
226	end DivRepAffinePullback
227	
228	end Curve
229	
230	end AlgebraicGeometry

8	/-!
9	# The F5 kit at the `Zar` level: the forward map needs no global chart certificate
10	
11	`DivRepAffKit.lean` states the F5 forward machinery with a supplied *globally certified*
12	family on each carve chart (`divRepPullAt` takes
13	`CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g`).  But that family is used only through
14	`(DivFam.mk (U i j)).toZar` — its certificate is consumed nowhere; the forward map is a
15	`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` of a *class*.
16	
17	This file restates the kit with the input weakened to a `DivFamZar` class on each chart.
18	That matters for the DD-R endgame: the certificate lane's output is Zariski-local
19	(`IsLocallyCertified`, see `DivSchemeCertZarSeed.lean` / `DivSchemeCertZarPointwise.lean`),
20	so a forward map demanding a global chart-ring certificate would have re-imposed exactly
21	the gate that was just removed.  With `divRepPullAtZar` it does not.
22	
23	The globally certified version is recovered by `divRepPullAtZar_toZar`, so this is a
24	weakening of the interface, not a second track.
25	
26	## Main declarations
27	
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepPullAtZar` — pull a supplied chart *class* to a test algebra.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepPullAtZar_toZar` — agreement with `divRepPullAt` on a globally
30	  certified chart family.
31	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivRepChartFamilyZar.IsCompatible` — the choice-independence clause at
32	  the `Zar` level.
33	-/

name: hgraph
description: The dependency graph — Horizon's vendored hgraph core keeps one file per statement/Lean declaration under <project>/hgraph/; `horizon graph frontier` ranks work and agents attach node-scoped comments and reviews. This is the only DAG engine.
---

Each project may carry an **hgraph**: a plain-files semantic graph under
`<project>/hgraph/` — one Markdown node per blueprint statement and per Lean
declaration, typed edges (`uses` = the hard dependency DAG, `formalizes` =
informal↔formal identity). `horizon graph sync` (run automatically at run boundaries)
reconciles the blueprint + Lean sources into it; your **authored** additions
(comments, reviews, metadata) are never touched by sync. The files are
committed to the workspace ledger like everything else.

Use `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> …`; when a workspace has one project,
`-p` is optional. Address nodes by `label:<latex-label>` or
`decl:<lean-fqname>` — raw ids are opaque hashes. Most commands accept `--json`.

## Sync it yourself — and act on the warnings

Don't wait for the run boundary: after you change blueprint statements,
`\uses{}`/`\lean{}` annotations, or Lean declarations, run
`"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> sync` and **read its output**. Sync prints warnings for exactly the defects
you can fix on the spot: `\uses{X} has no blueprint node` (missing/mistyped
label), `\lean{Name} not found in Lean sources` (renamed or unwritten
declaration), stale nodes whose source vanished. Fix what your change caused
before moving on; a warning you deliberately leave (e.g. a forward reference
you'll write next) gets a node comment or a memory item so the next session
knows it's intentional. Sync is idempotent and never touches your authored
comments/reviews/metadata.

## Read

- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> list --state ready` — nodes whose dependencies are all closed:
  provable *now*. Other states: `closed`, `blocked`, `formalized_open`.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> frontier` — the ready nodes ranked by how many downstream nodes a
  proof would unlock. **Use this when picking the next node to prove.**
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> get label:thm:foo` — one node: statement, `lean_status`
  (`lean_ok | mathlib_ok | sorry | empty`, derived from scanning the Lean, not
  from `\leanok`), deps, attached comments/reviews.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> ancestors label:thm:foo` — the dependency cone.
- `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> stats` — per-state counts for the project.

## Write — per-node progress lives WITH the node

- **Comment = failure memory / progress note on that node.** When an approach
  fails or you learn something node-specific, record it where the next session
  will look first:
  `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> add comment label:thm:foo --content "tried simp+ring, fails because …"`
  Agent authorship plus run/session/task provenance are filled from the run
  environment; do not copy the note into the blueprint.
- **Review = a Maths / Lean verdict** (independent axes, `good|bad`):
  `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> add review label:thm:foo --maths good --lean bad --lean-comment "statement ok; proof has a sorry at the succ case"`
- **Metadata**: `"$HORIZON_BIN" graph -p <project> modify node label:thm:foo --set status=verified`

Prefer node comments over inbox items for anything scoped to ONE node; use the
inbox (skill: `horizon-inbox`) for cross-node or cross-session coordination.

An edge `source --uses--> target` means *source depends on target*. A node is
"ready" when all of its dependencies are closed; prefer `frontier`, which ranks
ready nodes by what they unlock. The dashboard provides the workspace project
switcher and the chapter-collapsed Graphviz view.

## Relation to the blueprint

The DAG **is** the hgraph — there is no second engine and no parser fallback.
It is generated by resolving the blueprint's `\uses{}`/`\lean{}` annotations
against the real Lean sources, so keeping those annotations correct (skill:
`blueprint-conventions`) is exactly what keeps this graph correct. Unresolved
references surface as `horizon graph sync` warnings and as `dangling` entries — read
the warnings rather than trusting `dangling` alone.

9	# F5, the overlap agreement of the forward map (`informal/w4-ddr9-worksheet.md` §3.4)
10	
11	The affine forward map of DDR-9 is built by factorizing a morphism `v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver`
12	through the carve-chart atlas (`divScheme_exists_chartFactor`,
13	`Picard/DivSchemeAtlasFactor.lean:382` — landed), pulling the supplied universal chart family
14	back along each factorizing chart map (`divRepPullAt`), and gluing the resulting locally
15	certified classes (`DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`).
16	
17	Gluing needs the pieces to agree on overlaps.  This file proves that they do, from the chart
18	family's own compatibility hypothesis and nothing else:
19	
20	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divRepPullAt_mapAlgHom_eq_of_chartFactor` — **the overlap agreement**.
21	  Two chart presentations of the SAME `v`, over two carriers `A`, `A'`, restrict to the same
22	  locally certified class over any common `k`/`S`-tower ring `B`.
23	
24	This is the whole of §3.4's family-side W3, and it is free of the DDR9-U ε-identity U2: the
25	overlap of two presentations of one morphism is exactly the input `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible`
26	is stated to supply.  U2 is what will *prove* `IsCompatible` for the universal family; it is not
27	needed to *use* it.

30	glued class is independent of the factorization) and the two U2-gated laws; see the roadmap row

102	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B)) ≫ v.left := by
103	  have hAB : CommRingCat.ofHom omega.toRingHom ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)
104	      = CommRingCat.ofHom ((IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A B).comp omega).toRingHom := by
105	    rw [← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp]
106	    rfl
107	  have hSB : CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S A) ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A B)
108	      = CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S B) := by
109	    rw [← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]
110	  rw [← hAB, Spec.map_comp, Category.assoc, homega, ← Category.assoc, ← Spec.map_comp, hSB]

112	set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
113	-- The two `divRepPullAt` composites unfold `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom` through the chart-ring
114	-- notation; the defeq check is what costs (I-0227 budget).
115	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
116	/-- **The F5 overlap agreement** (w4-ddr9 §3.4, family-side W3): if two carve-chart
117	presentations `(i, j, ω)` over `A` and `(i', j', ω')` over `A'` present the SAME morphism
118	`v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver`, then the classes they pull back from a compatible universal
119	chart family agree after restriction to any common `k`/`S`-tower ring `B`.
120	
121	This is the hypothesis `DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat` consumes, and it is free of
122	the DDR9-U ε-identity: `DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible` is precisely the statement that two
123	chart points inducing the same morphism to `DivScheme` have equal pulled classes, and both
124	presentations induce `Spec.map (algebraMap S B) ≫ v.left` after pushforward.  U2 is what
125	will prove `IsCompatible` for the universal family, not what is needed to use it. -/
126	theorem divRepPullAt_mapAlgHom_eq_of_chartFactor
127	    (U : ∀ (i : (glueData k g r1).J) (j : (glueData k g r2).J),
128	      CertifiedDivisorFamily C (ChartRing i j) pi g)
129	    (hU : DivRepChartFamily.IsCompatible (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U)
130	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra k S] (v : overSpec k S ⟶ DivOver)
131	    {A A' B : Type u}
132	    [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [Algebra S A] [IsScalarTower k S A]
133	    [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A'] [Algebra S A'] [IsScalarTower k S A']
134	    [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra S B] [IsScalarTower k S B]
135	    [Algebra A B] [IsScalarTower k A B] [IsScalarTower S A B]
136	    [Algebra A' B] [IsScalarTower k A' B] [IsScalarTower S A' B]
137	    {i : (glueData k g r1).J} {j : (glueData k g r2).J}
138	    {i' : (glueData k g r1).J} {j' : (glueData k g r2).J}
139	    (omega : ChartRing i j →ₐ[k] A) (omega' : ChartRing i' j' →ₐ[k] A')
140	    (homega : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i j
141	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S A)) ≫ v.left)
142	    (homega' : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom omega'.toRingHom) ≫ ChartMap i' j'
143	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S A')) ≫ v.left) :
144	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A B)
145	        (divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega)
146	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A' B)
147	        (divRepPullAt (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega') := by
148	  have h1 := divRepPullAt_comp (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i j omega
149	    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A B)
150	  have h2 := divRepPullAt_comp (hpi := hpi) g r1 r2 b1 b2 U i' j' omega'
151	    (IsScalarTower.toAlgHom k A' B)
152	  refine h1.trans (Eq.trans ?_ h2.symm)
153	  exact hU i j i' j' _ _
154	    ((specMap_chartMap_pushforward hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 v omega homega).trans
155	      (specMap_chartMap_pushforward hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 v omega' homega').symm)
